findings.finding: ManaBox says displayed prices do not account for condition, language or location.
findings.implication: Accepted inventory attributes remain authoritative. Scan reference prices are neither exact-language/grade evidence nor acquisition cost.

findings.finding: Mana Pool publishes the ManaBox translation mint=NM, near_mint=LP, excellent/good=MP, light_played/played=HP, poor=DMG in its CSV workflow documentation.
findings.implication: Retain this provider import convention separately from physical grading. Do not silently downgrade inventory or presume that canonical near_mint authorizes an NM Mana Pool listing. Collect separate grade comparisons, including NM and LP scenarios; use MP as the documented import scenario for the three good/excellent rows. Physical grade acceptance remains unresolved for executable selling.

findings.finding: Wizards states Japanese alternate-art Mystical Archive cards have Japanese text and can appear in Collector Boosters of all languages.
findings.implication: Pack language does not establish printed language. Five English-labelled canonical SOA rows conflict with Japanese-only provider variants. Preserve holdings and withhold incompatible enrichment; do not manufacture English product matches or request a rescan by default.

findings.finding: Scryfall's Japanese M19 #185 response identifies Gigantosaurus as c7f7445d-0412-4aeb-b4a7-376b430e075b, language ja.
findings.implication: Supersede the earlier English default-catalog candidate with the exact Japanese identity without changing accepted physical inventory.

findings.finding: Retained Mana Pool OpenAPI v0.34.0 describes recent sale date, price in cents and quantity. Catalog samples contain at most 20 recent sales per variant and no stable sale identifiers.
findings.implication: Store exact reported prices, quantities and dates. Completeness and price unit-versus-line-total remain unverified. Never sum overlapping captures as unique transactions or call sample counts complete sales velocity. No automatic net/value computation from this evidence yet.

findings.finding: Mana Pool says its catalog depends on Scryfall and MTGJSON, and missing upstream data can cause missing products or variants.
findings.implication: Missing catalog products do not prove zero demand. Identity agreement among these services is not three independent market signals.

findings.finding: Mana Pool shipping is standardized and free shipping applies above package thresholds. Its shipping help distinguishes marketplace fees on products from processing fees affecting shipping charges.
findings.implication: Model package economics and verify the current fee schedule when implementing net proceeds. Do not apply an undifferentiated percentage to card price or mistake seller shipping credit for profit.
